name: Realm: gothic fantasy (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic gothic fantasy world photographed on location like a feature-film still - weathered dark stone, wet slate, iron and worn cloth, cold low light with mist and the warm pinpoints of candles and torches, desaturated colour with deep believable shadows; any magic is a faint ember or a cold glow
notes: For the fallen, the grieving and the exiled: the same fantasy backgrounds (backgrounds/fantasy/) in a colder, heavier light. Choose it per card with components.realm.
